Before You Begin

This is research education material, not a diagnosis, not a prescription and not medical advice. It aggregates published work; it is not original research data. It is here to support doing your own research.

The Goal In Plain Language

Why this protocol exists, and the stack at a glance.

How Confidence Is Labeled

What the studies show, what the app carries, and what is worth knowing. Research positioning is stated up front.

Evidence Labels

Human evidence, animal evidence, mechanism and hypothesis are each marked so you can see what the research shows and what the research does not show.

Discovery Lineage

Why this compound exists: the biological problem it was created for, the parent molecule it came from, and the pathway that led there. It was first discovered while studying that pathway.

Evidence Boundary

This does not show a benefit in humans for every use. Some claims are borrowed from an analog and are not yet tested at this dose. Mechanism does not equal outcome — that boundary matters.

Dosing And Schedule

Dose, schedule, reconstitution, the weekly grid, and administration. Volumes are given in mg, ml, IU and pen clicks.

What To Expect And How To Manage It

Common and temporary effects, tolerability, side effects, and the management levers available to you.

Supportive Lifestyle

Supportive lifestyle foundation: sleep hygiene, hydration, nutrition, protein targets and site rotation. Getting the most from the protocol.

Safety, Flags And Stops

Hard stops, caution items, contraindications, the start gate, and what to discuss first.

Monitoring

Lab monitoring and bloodwork: a baseline panel, checkpoints, what to watch, what to log, and a re-evaluation cadence.

What Practitioners And The Community Report

Community and practitioner practice observation from clinics. This is what people are doing, reported as practice — not as proof.

Supply Planning

Supply planning and product/SKU quantities are handled on a separate document; billing and the invoice never live in this guide.
